inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close piece of a pixel art battle stage background: a deep blue night sky with a few stars over a dark blue ridge far away, two dark red banners hanging from wooden bars at the sides, a wooden canopy frame below. In it, far off: a colossal bone walker: the skeleton of a giant long necked beast walking behind the far ridge at night, pale moonlit bones, a small dark tomb house strapped on its back with two warm glowing lanterns hanging from its eaves, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "one coherent pixel art scene, coherent pixel clusters, a clear readable creature, everything lit by the same light", "lighting": "Cool bright moonlight from the upper left and warm lantern light, deep blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground pale and lit so it reads clearly.", "color_palette": ["#0e1430", "#1e2a5a", "#3a4a8a", "#dfe6f2", "#8a2a28", "#f0b050", "#c8c8d4", "#9aa0b4", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "a deep blue night sky with a few stars over a dark blue ridge far away, two dark red banners hanging from wooden bars at the sides, a wooden canopy frame below", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [262, 273, 581, 507], "desc": "a colossal bone walker: the skeleton of a giant long necked beast walking behind the far ridge at night, pale moonlit bones, a small dark tomb house strapped on its back with two warm glowing lanterns hanging from its eaves, facing right, walking along behind the ridge, only its back, neck and skull showing above it"}]}}
